ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Operax needs access to your photos to send images in conversations.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Operax needs the camera to take photos and videos for your conversations.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Operax uses the microphone to record voice messages.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Operax can save media you receive to your photo library when you ask.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Operax uses your location during workouts to measure distance, pace, speed and elevation.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Operax uses your location during workouts, even with the screen off, to measure distance, pace and elevation.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Operax reads your workouts from the Health app (type, duration, distance and heart rate) to mark them done in your plan and share them with your coach.
